record.one_liner: Spend management platform (corporate cards, expenses, reimbursements, travel, bill pay) with a REST API for internal tools.
record.auth_notes: User tokens (Bearer, created in the Brex dashboard) authenticate your own account. OAuth 2.0 is for partner apps acting on other Brex accounts; the onboarding API uses client credentials.
record.access_notes: Token creation is done in the dashboard, and most APIs require an account admin to authorize. The Developer API agreement must be accepted by an admin. No pricing or plan page was fetched, so whether a paid Brex account is required is unverified.
record.api_notes: Documented API groups include Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Fields and Onboarding, plus others. Breadth judged from the landing page list only.
record.blocker_notes: Admin role needed for most APIs. Plan requirement not verified.
